skill.summary: Generate polished .xlsx workbooks from structured JSON — multiple sheets, frozen headers, filters, typed columns, formulas, totals, and French/Morocco format...

latestVersion.changelog: Strict validation: sheet names fail fast (no silent correction, case-insensitive duplicate check), boolean parsing accepts only true/false/1/0/yes/no/oui/non, integer columns reject non-whole values like 12.9, subtitle requires title. Added SQL-to-Excel recipe in references/.
